text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through town, I 
came across a food-report TV shoot in 
progress.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"TNDR" and "JUCY"... Just like a... 
"Supernova."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I understand completely! An animato 
bursting in one's mouth! A profound, 
permeating harmony...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: To express it――like this!!
choice_data_list: (What on earth are they talking about??)

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text: Uh, ah, what?? I... see...??

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The pair's food report is truly unique. 
Just as I was feeling, the filming crew 
looks completely flabbergasted. Just 
then――

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Earth-san and Universe-san! That 
chicken looks so delicious~

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... were you in the middle of 
filming? My apologies! Were we intruding?

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
――!! No, not at all!! Thank you so much 
for calling out to us...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The staff asked if the two of them 
wouldn't mind joining the shoot, ...almost 
as if crying out for salvation.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Of course, we'd love to help out! I've got 
my singing, so I should definitely be able 
to connect with Earth-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And Dia-chan, you'll understand what I 
mean through my song, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, leave it to me, Kita-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I will surely convey Universe-san and 
Earth-san's thoughts to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――And so, a mysterious game of Telephone 
began.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. "TNDR" and "JUCY".

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: In other words, like this, right? ~~~♪♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Which means―― Haaahhh~~~~~nn!!!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Mhm, mhm...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
This sensation... "Supernova." Can become 
"MAZN".

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: A splendid passione!! ~~~~~♪♪♪♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haa~n!! Haaaaahhhhh~~~~~~~n――!!!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ――! I see! I understand completely!

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text: R-Really...!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. What Universe-san is saying is――

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"It is thick and tender, juicy, immensely 
satisfying to eat, and delicious" is what 
she means♪

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Affirmative! ...It means "happy."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yay! That's our Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I know Kita-chan's songs so well. 
What you wanted to express reached me loud 
and clear♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A game of Telephone that seemed impossibly 
bizarre from the outside. Yet thanks to 
their strong bond, it seems it went off 
without a hitch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later, the location shoot video was 
uploaded online. Within the video, the 
smiles of the four girls were sparkling 
brightly.
